title: Yellow Smoky British Sausages Bangers And Mash
description: A classic British dish featuring smoky sausages and mashed potatoes, served with a side of meringue nests and grilled to perfection on a yakimono-grill.

ingredients.name: British sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably made with pork and seasoned with smoky spices

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: high-starch variety like Russet or Idaho

instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat, approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Grill the British sausages for about 5 minutes on each side, or until they are nicely browned and cooked through.
While the sausages are cooking, boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water until they are tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with olive oil, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
In a separate pan, sauté the sliced onion and minced garlic in a little bit of olive oil until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the chicken broth to the pan and bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
To serve, place a grilled sausage on top of a mound of mashed potatoes, spoon some of the onion and garlic sauce over the top, and garnish with a meringue nest.
